what: Hand-written recall cases for smCLM_02 phase 0. Each case is a query, a pool of stored memories in the shape paratroop_harness_02 saves them, and the id of the one that should come back first. Written before any training data existed; nothing here may be trained on.

groups.A: the query and the right memory share a content word; BM25 already wins these and the hybrid must not lose them
groups.B: the query and the right memory share no content word at all; same meaning, other words
groups.C: another memory in the pool shares words with the query but not its meaning

fields.id: case id, group letter plus the case number
fields.pool: the stored memories, each an id and its text; 8 to 12 of them
fields.answer: the pool id that must rank first
fields.note: only where a case needed a word of explanation
